subject.title: [Feature]: Mobile apps: read-only workspace file browser (browse, preview, share)

question: Should OpenClaw finish the mobile read-only workspace browser on top of the merged agents.workspace list/get gateway contract?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but exposing agent workspace file reads through mobile clients is a security/product boundary and the issue has a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Review and land the mobile stack
options.body: Use the merged gateway contract as the base and review the iOS and Android PRs for platform UX, proof, and security consistency.

options.title: Narrow the mobile surface
options.body: Approve only a smaller subset, such as browse and preview without share/export, and ask the open PRs to match that accepted scope.

options.title: Pause the mobile feature
options.body: Keep the issue open but defer mobile browsing until maintainers revisit the broader workspace-management direction.

recommendation.title: Review and land the mobile stack
recommendation.body: Use the merged gateway contract as the base and review the iOS and Android PRs for platform UX, proof, and security consistency.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the current issue and the linked split implementation path that maintainers need to accept, narrow, or pause.
